articleTitle: Webflow Homepage Teardown: Jan 2020 to Jun 2026
h1: How Webflow rewrote its homepage over 6 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jan 2020 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "Break the code barrier" — direct product statement.
Section headings later removed include: "Who uses Webflow" and "Get up and running fast".

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Make your website a growth engine" — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for high-performing brands", "300,000+ brands move the needle with Webflow", "From idea to impact, faster".
CTAs no longer present include: "Get started — it's free", "Dell prototypes faster and more effectively.", "Heco builds world-class sites for clients.".

messaging.after: Make your website a growth engine
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: Build responsive websites in your browser, then launch with our world-class hosting or export your code. Discover the professional website platform built for your business.
messaging.after: Design, build, optimize, and rank in AI search — all in Webflow. Enterprise-grade security, CMS, hosting, and AEO built in. Trusted by over 300k teams.
messaging.note: The new description is shorter and more neutral in tone. Whether this is intentional de-emphasis or a simplification pass is not determinable from text alone.

messaging.before: Responsive web design tool, CMS, and hosting platform | Webflow
messaging.after: Webflow: The agentic web platform for modern businesses

snapshots.above_fold_structure: Left-aligned headline 'Break the code barrier' with subtext and blue CTA button, paired with right-aligned isometric product imagery stack.
Top navigation bar with logo and sign-in, followed by hero section with centered headline 'Make your website a growth engine' over full-width background imagery, with supporting subtext and blue CTA.

visual-analysis.visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a balanced two-column hero layout with moderate proof density to a full-width, immersive hero experience with increased visual hierarchy, more prominent navigation, and significantly denser social proof through client logos and case study imagery throughout the page.
